gloss: to ride past one's stop; to overshoot

definitions.gloss: to ride past one's stop; to miss one's station
definitions.explanation: To stay on a train, bus, or other vehicle past the intended stop, usually because of falling asleep or being distracted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}し→乗り越し：23194_norikoshi⟧た。
⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧しまって⟦{終点|しゅうてん}→終点：05457_shuuten⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}し→乗り越し：23194_norikoshi⟧た。
examples.english: I fell asleep and rode all the way to the last stop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}し→乗り越し：23194_norikoshi⟧た⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{精算|せいさん}{機|き}→精算機：10189_seisanki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{差額|さがく}→差額：15775_sagaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you ride past your stop, please pay the fare difference at the adjustment machine.

notes:
A practical word for everyday train and bus travel in Japan. Very commonly experienced by commuters who fall asleep on the train.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}し→乗り越し：23194_norikoshi⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧: fare adjustment (for riding past your stop)
- ⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}し→乗り越し：23194_norikoshi⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}{機|き}→精算機：10189_seisanki⟧: fare adjustment machine
- {一駅|ひとえき}{乗|の}り{越|こ}す: to ride one station past
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧{乗|の}り{越|こ}す: to accidentally ride past one's stop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす→乗り過ごす：07928_norisugosu⟧: to ride past — very similar meaning, slightly more common in speech
- ⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧: to ride over/surmount — different meaning (to overcome an obstacle)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese train stations have ⟦{精算|せいさん}{機|き}→精算機：10189_seisanki⟧ (fare adjustment machines) or ⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧ (adjustment counters) specifically for passengers who ride past their intended stop.
